firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently went snorkeling starts.
clarifications: Turns then proceed clockwise. If the game continues to another round, the booklet says to repeat setup but does not separately name a different starter.
internalEvidence: Haumea's product page https://www.haumeagames.com/products/snorkeling links this bilingual/trilingual booklet. The English setup on PDF page 1 names the last person to go snorkeling, followed by clockwise turns. Page 1 also states that a new round repeats setup; the PDF credits on page 2 give ©2025 Haumea Games. Page 1 was rendered and read.
